interpretation.directlyEstablished: The first setup systemctl command was rejected by the systemd runtime detection check inside its isolated environment.
interpretation.sourceBackedExplanation: Upstream systemd v255 sd_booted checks the existence of /run/systemd/system. The system bus helper emits the observed detection error before connecting to the bus when this check fails. The frozen setup profile mounts a private /run and does not provide that marker.
interpretation.inferenceLimit: The marker was not directly inspected in the namespace by this capture. Upstream v255 behavior is supporting source evidence, not a fresh verification of the installed build.

diagnostics.sdkSocketDiagnosticClassification: unclassified; retained separately from explicit successful cleanup receipts

nextLocalInvestigation.preferredCandidate: Evaluate a fixed empty runtime marker only after proving the private mount origin and holding and rechecking parent directory descriptors; retain all existing bus, identity and mount guards.

limitations: This capture is not a successful setup, release rehearsal or production acceptance.
Four service status records do not prove uninterrupted traffic or compare full invocation and start-time records.
The zero-unit low-priority SSH query is not evidence of a 192MiB or 20-percent setup cgroup.
The error does not establish that host PID1 is not systemd or that the host system bus is down.
A runtime marker alone does not establish bus connectivity or later setup success.
